stops.name: Parco delle Groane
stops.detail: The Parco delle Groane e della Brughiera Briantea ("Park of the Groane and Brianza moorland") is a nature reserve in Lombardy, Italy. Established in 1976 (as Parco delle Groane) and enlarged in [dated source], it covers over 8,000 hectares of woods and moorlands (locally known as groane) in the upper Po Plain northwest of Milan (between 160 and 300 meters above sea level), across the territory of 28 municipalities in the provinces of Milan, Como and Monza.
